evidence: Reviewed the actual frozen XLSX with openpyxl: Quality Checks row 11 (check 10) requires a separate pinned verifier and unchanged claude-code / z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx / OpenRouter credential block, explicitly allows the claude-code fallback, and says public network requires no allowlist. Deterministic Checks rows 2, 10, 11, 29 and 43 cover public-network allowance, Docker/npm/pip pinning and judge overrides; Internal Quality Checks row 11 still mentions an allowlist, but that internal annotation is superseded by the shipped Quality Checks row and SKILL.md Delivery profile. Frozen references/quality-checks.md:47-48 and staged-task-contract.md:62-74,113-140 agree with this interpretation. All task/rules references below are under .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/. task/task.toml:28 states environment_mode = "separate"; lines 30-35 contain precisely REWARDKIT_JUDGE = "claude-code", REWARDKIT_MODEL = "z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx", ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://openrouter.ai/api", ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "". Line 38 sets public network. Python tomllib verified exact key/value equality to rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml, and a byte comparison of the complete verifier.env block, including whitespace before the following table, returned True. The auth value is the expected variable reference, not a literal credential. task/tests/Dockerfile:1-2 uses node:22-bookworm-slim and python:3.12-slim, exactly as the template; lines 17-21 pin claude-code@2.1.281, codex@0.151.0, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1; line 31 pins harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7. Lines 33-38 install Chromium through the pinned Playwright package, and lines 43-45 copy the verifier's own /tests. These are template version tags, not immutable image digests; no stronger claim of byte-reproducible future rebuilds is made. Unversioned apt packages at lines 12-14 are explicitly NOTE-only in the workbook, not a failure. The complete verifier Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template (SHA256 72998ab8ef0e4225e63b88fccdb754943c54022e25da355035efe7f759a55fdd); environment/Dockerfile and tests/test.sh also byte-match their templates. Agent environment/Dockerfile:14-15 copies only instructions and assets, not tests or the solution. Parsed all five task/tests/{gates/{render,constraints},scored/{functional,polish,visual}}/judge.toml files: every line 2 is judge = "claude-code", and every [judge] has no model, reasoning_effort, temperature or weight key. Their isolated = false at line 5 is the expected judge setting; verifier-container separation is controlled by task.toml, not this field. Dockerfile:24-29 configures the separately installed Codex compatibility CLI; it does not select the active judge. tests/test.sh:63-66 requires the runner/model environment values, and lines 203-209 invoke rewardkit without a runner or model override. Both initial app launch at lines 104-111 and restart at lines 160-167 use env -i, supplying only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT and DB_PATH to the unprivileged app; the configured judge credentials are not inherited by the app. Read-only independent validation verified all 50 task manifest entries and all 34 rule entries against manifest.json with zero hash mismatches. In-memory negative configuration variants rejected a model override introduced only in visual, an incorrect auth variable reference, and environment_mode = same; the unchanged public-network, no-allowlist configuration with judge isolated = false passed. This establishes source/configuration compliance for check 10. qc/runs/coldwater-2026-09-30-hardening/golden/run-golden-20260930-070504/RESULTS.json:3-6 explicitly records paid_provider=false, network=none and direct pinned Playwright; its observed MCP version 0.0.79 is consistent with the Dockerfile, but it is not a configured provider/judge run. Live credential resolution, provider authentication and complete judge launch/grading remain unmeasured and are not inferred from this Pass; qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md places those separate runtime requirements under the runtime evidence checks.
counterexample: False-fail witness: the shipped conforming configuration uses a separate verifier container while each [judge].isolated is false, and public networking has no allowed_hosts. Rejecting either feature would contradict the current profile; the read-only TOML validator accepted this configuration. False-pass witness for a representative-file-only review: keep render correct but introduce model = "some/other-model" into visual's [judge]; an in-memory copy was rejected as 'judge 4 forbidden overrides'. The current source was parsed across all five files and contains no such override. Wrong ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN substitution and same-environment variants were also rejected without modifying any file or making network calls.
